Two faces, drawn for one game
Beastcut
& Beakwork

The type of The Birds & The Beasts. One parametric skeleton, two faces: Beastcut is condensed, black and flat-sided, with true small caps in place of a lowercase — headings, buttons and any number that is a score. Beakwork is the same bones at a tenth of the weight, with a tall x-height and terminals that stop dead — everything that is a sentence.

Beakwork — text
Two beasts in, one chick out.

The barn is three floors and a nest on top. Post beasts on floors, two per floor, paid from a Feed budget; open the door and a wave walks in at the bottom. Whatever climbs off the top eats an egg, and the eggs are your health.

Resemblance: 62% sire · 38% dam · might 14 · vigor 9 · guile 11

Take them

WOFF, about 8kB each, no licence to read: they were cut for this game and you can do what you like with them. In the game itself they are base64'd into the one HTML file, because it has no external resources by design.

Cut by tools/beastfont in the games repo — back to The Birds & The Beasts.
